matches.title: AC Milan vs Inter
matches.description: Watch AC Milan vs Inter highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 5, 2026. Two of Italy’s biggest giants renewed their historic rivalry on the international stage as AC Milan and Inter faced off in a highly anticipated summer clash. Both sides looked to assert their dominance and fine-tune their tactics in a match that promised high-intensity football from the opening whistle. Tactical Battle in the Opening Period On August 5, 2026 , the atmosphere was electric as the two Milanese clubs took to the field. The first half was a cagey affair, with both teams prioritizing defensive organization over all-out attack. While there were occasional chances and bursts of pace, neither goalkeeper was truly tested during the opening 45 minutes as the tactical battle took center stage in this prestigious friendly match . Dimarco Breaks the Deadlock The tempo shifted dramatically in the second half . In the 52nd minute, Inter found the breakthrough they were looking for. A well-worked move ended with Federico Dimarco finding space to strike, sending the ball into the back of the net to give the Nerazzurri a 1-0 lead. The goal forced AC Milan to take more risks and push higher up the pitch as they searched for a way back into the contest. Late Drama and the Equalizer As the clock ticked down, the pressure from the Rossoneri finally paid off. In the 84th minute, a crucial foul in the box resulted in a penalty for AC Milan . Christopher Nkunku stepped up under immense pressure and coolly converted the spot-kick to level the score at 1-1. The final moments were marked by rising tensions, including a yellow card for Pervis Estupiñán in stoppage time, as the fierce sports rivalry ensured a competitive finish to the draw.
